messages:
ellen (Revenue Ops): Quick FYI  we received a customer invoice (LATAM-ACCT-004) that was billed in ARS but recognized in USD at an outdated FX rate. Looks like recognized revenue for March is overstated by ~$2,200 after revaluation. Uploaded invoice + fx file: s3://redwood-bills/latam/LATAM-ACCT-004.pdf :file_folder:

isaac (Billing Ops): Can you paste the invoice excerpt and the FX numbers you used? Want to confirm whether this was a billing export or AR conversion issue.

ellen (Revenue Ops): Excerpt: ```
Invoice: LATAM-ACCT-004 (Mar 28)
Service: Hosted tokens - Mar 1-28 | 2,000,000 tokens | ARS 180,000 | invoice FX: 1 USD = 160 ARS -> USD 1,125.00
Billing export used FX 1 USD = 150 ARS -> USD 1,200.00 (recognized)
Delta -> USD 75.00 (per invoice) x 30 similar invoices = USD 2,250.00
```

paul (FP&A): Aggregate impact ~ $2,250, under our $5k restatement threshold but after close. Recommend prior-period adjusting JE to correct March recognized revenue and note FX variance in close pack.

mona (Controller): Policy: FX revaluation or billing conversion errors that affect prior close are handled with a prior-period adjustment if below threshold. Provide GL mapping and supporting docs.

isaac (Billing Ops): Root cause: billing export used a stale FX snapshot from service fxfetcher due to a cron failure on Mar 29. I'll open a ticket and backfill correct FX for affected invoices.

fx-bot (fx-bot): New ticket: BILL-9801  fxfetcher cron failed Mar 29, stale FX applied to billing export. Link: https://tickets.internal/BILL-9801

ellen (Revenue Ops): Proposed JE to post in March: debit 4001 Hosted Revenue $2,250.00; credit 2105 Customer Credits $2,250.00. JE memo: "Prior-period FX conversion correction - LATAM invoices (BILL-9801)". I will aggregate and attach sample invoices + ticket.

paul (FP&A): I support. Also recommend we add a small FX reserve line in April close (estimate $3k) until backfill completes and we confirm no additional affected invoices. I'll update the close pack narrative.

mona (Controller): I approve the JE mapping for < $5k. Post in March period with attachments and include the ticket. If we find >50 affected invoices or >$10k total, escalate to audit.

isaac (Billing Ops): I'll patch the cron, re-run FX pulls, and re-export affected invoices for AR. Adding a monitoring alert for fxfetcher failures.

ellen (Revenue Ops): I'll prepare the JE bundle now and queue NetSuite request. Targeting posting EOD tomorrow. Will @mona when ready for sign-off. :white_check_mark:

fx-bot (fx-bot): Reminder scheduled: JE approval pending - NetSuite task 9012. Link: https://alerts.internal/journal/9012
